import os
import random

C = 1234567
MASK32 = 0xFFFFFFFF


def _rotl2_8(v):
    v &= 0xFF
    return ((v << 2) | (v >> 6)) & 0xFF


def _f_diff(d):
    dx0 = d & 0xFF
    dx1 = (d >> 8) & 0xFF
    dx2 = (d >> 16) & 0xFF
    dx3 = (d >> 24) & 0xFF
    dy2 = _rotl2_8((dx3 ^ dx2) + (dx1 ^ dx0))
    dy3 = _rotl2_8(dx3 + dy2)
    dy1 = _rotl2_8((dx1 ^ dx0) + dy2)
    dy0 = _rotl2_8(dx0 + dy1)
    return dy0 | (dy1 << 8) | (dy2 << 16) | (dy3 << 24)


def _diff_state_before_last(delta_pt):
    dL = (delta_pt >> 32) & MASK32
    dR = (delta_pt & MASK32) ^ dL
    for _ in range(3):
        dL, dR = dR, dL ^ _f_diff(dR)
    return dL, dR


def _right_half_before_last(ct):
    hi = (ct >> 32) & MASK32
    lo = ct & MASK32
    return lo ^ hi


def attack(encrypt_fn):
    seed = 0x5A17
    rng = random.Random(seed)

    while True:
        p = rng.getrandbits(64)
        delta = rng.getrandbits(64)
        if delta == 0:
            continue
        dL3, dR3 = _diff_state_before_last(delta)
        if dR3 == 0:
            continue

        d_expected = _f_diff(dR3)

        p2 = p ^ delta
        c1 = encrypt_fn(p)
        c2 = encrypt_fn(p2)
        a = _right_half_before_last(c1)
        b = _right_half_before_last(c2)

        if (a ^ b) != dR3:
            continue

        candidates = []
        for x in range(0x10000):
            k = (x * C) & MASK32
            from feal import f_function
            if (f_function(a ^ k) ^ f_function(b ^ k)) == d_expected:
                candidates.append(k)
                if len(candidates) > 1:
                    break

        if len(candidates) == 1:
            return candidates[0]

MASK32 = 0xFFFFFFFF
MASK64 = 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF

_A = 0x80800000
_B = 0x02000000
_DELTA_L3 = _A

def _right_before_last(ct):
    hi = (ct >> 32) & MASK32
    lo = ct & MASK32
    return lo ^ hi


def _pair_constraint(encrypt_fn, p):
    c1 = encrypt_fn(p)
    c2 = encrypt_fn(p ^ _DELTA_PT)
    a = _right_before_last(c1)
    b = _right_before_last(c2)
    target = ((((c1 >> 32) ^ (c2 >> 32)) & MASK32) ^ _DELTA_L3) & MASK32
    return a, b, target


def attack(encrypt_fn):
    from feal import f_function

    constraints = []
    base = 0x0123456789ABCDEF

    def extend(n):
        start = len(constraints)
        for i in range(start, start + n):
            p = (base + i * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15) & MASK64
            constraints.append(_pair_constraint(encrypt_fn, p))

    extend(4)

    while True:
        candidates = []
        for x in range(0x10000):
            k = (x * C) & MASK32
            for a, b, target in constraints:
                if (f_function(a ^ k) ^ f_function(b ^ k)) != target:
                    break
            else:
